amendments.decision: Phase 3 thin vertical proof runs as a real linear Scout graph: acquire -> assess -> present with COMPLETE edges only; assessment labels stay in the assessment artifact.
acceptance: one bounded acquisition source saves postings visible even if assessment fails
assessment consumes saved postings and selected local evidence
presentation shows results and questions in the simple tracking UI
one graph traversal owns the run with per-node status, evidence and available cost/usage
an interrupted run resumes without duplicating acquisition records
not_required: custom outcomes (S12 D2) until labels select edges
amendments.first_step: Luna traces node execution integration (callable, inputs/outputs, evidence, failure/restart) before sizing or dispatch; Terra reviews; root final gate
amendments.sizing: not sized; must not be called small before the integration trace
amendments.review_status: pending: amendment and Luna integration trace need their own Terra review (Luna/max trace in progress, documentation only, as of 2026-09-22)
